title: tRNA charged fraction over the cell cycle (both seeds)
caption: Mean tRNA charging stays high (~0.97) throughout the cell cycle.
interpretation: Mean fraction of charged tRNA (averaged over the 86 tRNA species, shaded band = per-species range) stays high at ~0.97 (median 0.966) for both seeds across the cell cycle. High, stable charging is consistent with amino-acid-replete exponential growth.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
